bias_and_edge_obligations.R_MPN_tolerance_effective_C: UNKNOWN for every new position; no passive selected
bias_and_edge_obligations.disabled: For each high-Z node: signed injection over its entire trajectory, Rmax, return/noise and initial charge must keep/discharge it below the applicable LOW threshold within a justified interval. Actual conditions do not meet that argument yet.
bias_and_edge_obligations.active_HIGH: Each output must source V/Rmin plus receiver/protection/wiring load inside a matched I-V/load envelope. A pulldown never vetoes active HIGH.
bias_and_edge_obligations.active_LOW: Sinking positive injection versus sourcing leakage through the pulldown are different load signs. Do not extend a +100uA VOL fixture to all signed LOW loads.
bias_and_edge_obligations.ordinary_FF_inputs: R_CLR/R_CLK discharge and release edges must satisfy FF input transition conditions at FF.6/.1; TXU's Schmitt INPUT does not turn downstream FF into a Schmitt receiver.

TXU_to_FF_light_load.condition: TXU +/-100uA distinct tests with input footnotes; FF3.0..3.6V thresholds. Actual signed load and return errors unqualified.

conditioned_source_point.heavy_load_counterexample: At both3V TXU +10mA VOLmax0.8V equals FF VILmax0.8V: zero positive LOW uncertainty allowance. -10mA VOH2.2V gives only0.2V arithmetic HIGH difference. Not a selected10mA load, nor compatible with the5mA local external budget by assumption.
conditioned_source_point.timing: TXU0.5..11ns propagation/6.6..29ns enable/18.5..42ns disable are distinct fixtures; none is output slew. FF pulses>=2.7ns/setup1.3ns/hold1.2ns/recovery1.2ns and input<=10ns/V retain039 conditions. No numerical C pulse or completion timer derived.
conditioned_source_point.recovery_requirement: At each FF pin, earliest valid rising CLK must follow latest clean /CLR release by applicable recovery plus actual uncertainty; D/PRE valid for applicable setup/hold and pulse intervals. Cross-channel TXU delay or enable commonality does not establish this.
